field.label: Server
field.help: Hostname or address of the iperf3 server.

field.label: Port
field.help: Public servers often run one test at a time per port, try another port when the server is busy.

field.label: Source interface
field.help: Use the address of this interface as source address (-B).

field.label: Duration
field.help: Test duration in seconds. A test still running 30 seconds after this time is stopped.
